title: kate-ui: name an edit that misses the buffer
summary: An out-of-bounds edit and a mismatched edit get different sentences. A missing path keeps its sentence. The test goes in the existing notice tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: notice.rs is a private module of layout.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Keep command_notice pub(crate) and its cfg_attr. Replace the Apply arm with two arms. CommandError::Apply(ApplyError::OutOfBounds { .. }) returns The edit is past the end. CommandError::Apply(ApplyError::OldTextMismatch { .. }) returns The edit does not match the buffer. Use kate_text::ApplyError. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch the NoFile, AlreadyOpen, UnknownView, Save, Load, or Transaction arms. The existing test no_path_names_the_missing_file stays green. The test an_out_of_bounds_edit_names_the_end builds CommandError::Apply of OutOfBounds with edit 0, end Offset(3), and len Offset(1). The sentence is The edit is past the end. OldTextMismatch with edit 0, expected a, and found b has the sentence The edit does not match the buffer. NoFile stays This document has no path. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: layout::notice::tests::an_out_of_bounds_edit_names_the_end
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. Both apply errors say the edit was rejected. After the change an out-of-bounds edit names the end. A mismatched edit names the buffer. A missing path keeps its sentence.
